report:
Pinning memos in the "Explore section" not working

### Describe the bug

Pinning a memo in your personal area works just fine, however when pinning a memo in the explore section (e.g. a protected post) it has no effect.

### Steps to reproduce

create two posts, pin the older one in the explore section. Pinning it has no effect.

### The version of Memos you're using


0.25 (canary)

evidence.quote: Actually, it's WAI. The pinned content is only displayed in the Home and User Profile pages.

confirmation.quote: I see, is there a specific reason for that? We use Memos as a team and it would be nice to be able to pin announcements/important info in the public/protected section as well.

ambiguity: D: pin action 'has no effect' in Explore while it works on the personal page reads like a broken feature/regression in a canary build; B: pinning may be scoped to personal views by design. Nothing in the report distinguishes them.
decisive_code: web/src/pages/Explore.tsx: Explore calls useMemoFilters({includePinned:false}) and useMemoSorting({pinnedFirst:false}), whereas Home.tsx and UserProfile.tsx pass includePinned:true / pinnedFirst:true — pin ordering is deliberately disabled on Explore only.
notes: No code change followed; closed not_planned (stale) after WAI verdict.

reviews.decidable_why: Source shows pinned-first ordering only in Home/Profile views, but judging it 'intended' vs defect needs maintainer intent.
The source shows the Explore list does not sort by pinned, but whether that is intended needs maintainer intent.
